propositions: The rebar-brainstorm skill documentation lacks explicit guidance that blocked/not-yet-claimable tickets represent a successful terminal state of the review cycle requiring no further agent action.
Agents are using rebar review-plan --force to bypass the claimability fast-fail on blocked tickets when given vague human instructions, defeating the gate's intent.
The skill must prohibit review-plan --force as an agent move and frame it as a human-operator-only escape hatch.
Agents should ask a clarifying question naming the block and risk rather than inferring authorization to force-review blocked tickets.
Forced reviews mint signed attestations against non-final dependencies that silently go stale, creating a gap between the attestation and actual ticket state.
